text: Build job 4, part 1, of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md sections 5.1 and 10, decision D111): a pre-merge check on a pull request's head, as a command (for example athena check --pr-head <base> <head>) that passes only when every commit between the base and the head classifies (via land.rs pr_commits) as a job landing whose verification passed and whose prediction precedes its outcome, a declared intervention, or records-only, and the head's content equals the last job landing's verified content plus only records-only commits after it; otherwise it fails naming each offending commit. Add it to .github/workflows/ci.yml as a new job on pull requests that does not block merging yet (it becomes required at the cutover, job 7), and list .github/workflows/ci.yml as a governance deliverable. Tests: a head with an unverified commit fails; a head shaped like a real Athena pull request passes; a head with a declared intervention after the job landing fails, since a squash of it is not a valid landing until the cutover.
